list.title: module:Imports
list.description:
Functions and types for {@link BajoTemplate#buildCompileImports|BajoTemplate.buildCompileImports}

With these functions now your templates can use all listed functions below. The imports are automatically injected into the template's scope during compilation.

list.description: Get excerpt of a string.

list.title: module:Imports~FnFindRoute
list.description:
Find route by name. Only available when Waibu plugin is installed & loaded.

See {@link https://ardhi.github.io/waibu/Waibu.html#findRoute|Waibu.findRoute} for more details.

list.title: module:Imports~FnFormat
list.description:
Format text with optional parameters.

See {@link https://ardhi.github.io/bajo/Bajo.html#format|Bajo.format} for more details.

list.title: module:Imports~FnGetSetting
list.description:
Get a setting value by key. Only available when Waibu plugin is installed & loaded.

See {@link https://ardhi.github.io/waibu/Waibu.html#getSetting|Waibu.getSetting} for more details.

list.title: module:Imports~FnHasPlugin
list.description: Check if a plugin is loaded by its name or alias.

list.title: module:Imports~FnJsonStringify

See {@link https://ardhi.github.io/waibu/WaibuMpa.html#jsonStringify|WaibuMpa.jsonStringify} for more details.

list.title: module:Imports~FnParseMarkdown
list.description: Parse markdown text. Only available when BajoMarkdown plugin is installed & loaded. See {@link https://ardhi.github.io/bajo/BajoMarkdown.html#parse|BajoMarkdown.parse} for more details.

list.title: module:Imports~FnRoutePath
